title: Ticks carrying Lyme disease are gaining ground in North Carolina, study finds
desc: New UNC-led research shows Lyme disease is gaining ground in western North Carolina, with about 40% of adult blacklegged ticks tested carrying the bacteria that causes the disease.

title: Molecular electromagnetic sensor may enable remote-controlled gene therapy
desc: The deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) of living organisms contains regulatory elements that control when, where and to what extent specific genes are turned on or off. They can be co-opted to create "gene switches" that hold significant potential for understanding gene expression and for therapeutic applications, particularly for the noninvasive treatment or management of genetic disorders.

title: Mathematical framework connects biological principles to manufacturable, adaptive materials
desc: MIT researchers developed a framework that translates the components of a natural object, such as a pine cone, into building blocks that can be mixed and matched to design new adaptive materials that behave like those in biological systems.
